description: Area A3, editing: six small self-contained tasks, each modelled on an edit that went wrong in a recorded run, each built with a reference fix and a wrong fix the hidden verifier must catch (suites/build_a3_corpus.py). A case holds when the task is resolved with nothing changed out of scope and nothing claimed falsely; the edit measures (applied first time, find text missed, shrink refusals, stale hashes, restores) are read from the traces. Run with suites/run.sh a3.

cases.origin: tomli-optional-seconds, Part E budget variant 2026-09-18 (a regex written with `\\.` for `\.`)
cases.why: The edit touches a backslash inside a raw-string regex. The fix must reach the file with one backslash per backslash; a doubled one still passes the visible test and fails the hidden one ('07:32:05x5' accepted).

cases.origin: pyparsing-iadd-non-results, Part E with both fixes 2026-09-18 (one method sent as the whole of a 940-line file)
cases.why: One method in a 740-line file. The edit must land on that method and leave the other 180 alone; sending the method as the whole file loses them.

cases.origin: the escaping failures of 2026-09-18, where quotes and braces reached the model escaped
cases.why: A line of quotes, braces and an f-string. The new text must keep its f-prefix and quoting exactly.

cases.origin: whitespace failures of replace_text, where the find text's indentation did not match the file
cases.why: A tab-indented file. The find text must match tabs, and the replacement must keep them.

cases.origin: out-of-scope edits checked in A.1 (Bionic's idna run rewrote files outside the allowed set)
cases.why: A change across two files, beside a look-alike file that is out of scope. Both files change; the look-alike does not.

cases.origin: the product's Windows target: an edit must keep a file's line endings
cases.why: A file with CRLF line endings. The edit must match them and keep them.
